summary: Berlin resident, aviation enthusiast, technical background in software engineering, strong advocate for environmental sustainability, interest in electric and hybrid aircraft development, critical of traditional fuel consumption practices, engaged in discussions about climate change and energy policies, knowledgeable about aviation logistics and queuing theory, experienced in flight simulation (X-Plane user), familiar with open-source software development, critical of corporate monopolies and political influence, supportive of social welfare systems, views on euthanasia shaped by personal experiences in the Netherlands, advocates for responsible healthcare policies, and has a nuanced understanding of international relations, particularly regarding Russia and the EU.
